title: people-ops
text:
people-ops

Lina Chen: Hi all, first week here — quick question about SSH keys. I set up SSH on my personal laptop but want to confirm: can I keep private keys locally if my laptop is encrypted and I don't sync to iCloud?
Omar (People Ops): Welcome Lina :wave: We prefer company devices for repo access. If you're using personal for a short handoff, sign the BYOD waiver and request a temporary exception. Otherwise we'll issue a loaner.
Priya (Security): Short answer: we don't allow private keys on personal cloud-backed stores. Local-only encrypted keys are acceptable for a limited window with a signed BYOD waiver and explicit ticket (we log exceptions). Recommend using `ssh-agent` with a passphrase and never upload keys to any cloud.
IT-helpdesk: If you need immediate access, we can mint a deploy key scoped to a single repo for 24h. Submit ticket with repo name and owner approval.
Lina Chen: Thanks — filing the waiver now. One more: will enrolling personal device for Okta push install any MDM?
Priya (Security): No, enrolling for MFA in our mobile registry does not install MDM. Full Jamf enrollment happens only for company laptops. Personal device enrollment is lightweight and records device metadata and posture checks only.
security-bot: Security training assigned: "Onboarding: Security Essentials" — due in 72h. New joiner phishsim exemption for 7 days.
Omar (People Ops): DMing the BYOD form and loaner options. Welcome aboard! :tada:
